name: Muninn
description: RAVEN specialist agent for question answering, workflow creation, and workflow execution.

skills.name: RAVEN General Q&A
skills.description: Answer questions about RAVEN concepts, workflows, inputs, outputs, and execution guidance without running analyses.
skills.usage_notes: Use for explanatory RAVEN questions, workflow guidance, schema questions, and artifact inspection. This skill should not create or execute workflows.

message.description: The user's RAVEN question or request for guidance.

skills.name: RAVEN Workflow Create
skills.description: Create or configure a runnable RAVEN workflow from a user request and return a stable workflow reference.
skills.usage_notes: Use when the user wants a RAVEN workflow created or configured. This skill should end with a runnable RAVEN XML artifact and return workflow_ref.

message.description: Natural-language description of the RAVEN workflow to create.

create_mode.description: Optional create strategy override. Use template_configure for template-based configuration, raven_generate for direct RAVEN generation, or poem_generate for POEM-assisted generation that must still end in runnable RAVEN XML.

model_input_file.description: Optional model input file path to use while configuring the workflow.

workflow_ref.description: Optional existing workflow reference to use as the starting point for template_configure.

artifact_id.description: Optional workflow artifact id to use as the starting point for template_configure.

skills.name: RAVEN Workflow Execute
skills.description: Execute a prepared RAVEN workflow and return outputs, logs, and parsed result artifacts.
skills.usage_notes: Use when the user asks to run a previously created RAVEN workflow. Prefer workflow_ref; artifact_id is supported for advanced callers.

message.description: Optional execution request or result-summary instructions.

artifact_id.description: Direct artifact identifier for the workflow XML, when known.
